uk.s: Affiliate Rewards for You & Your Users!
Campaign rewards will be fully distributed within 3 business days after the campaign ends.
Deposit campaign rewards are available only to new users who register during the campaign period.
Net Deposit = Total Deposits during the campaign period− Total Withdrawals during the campaign period.
This campaign is open exclusively to specifically invited affiliates;
Affiliates that have not been invited are not eligible to participate.
If users have doubts about the result of the activities, please note the official appeal period is 2 months after the end of the campaign;
For any duplicate or fake accounts found to be cheating or attempting to conduct fraudulent behaviors, the platform will withhold the distribution of the rewards;
For any manipulations attempting to get the rewards illegally, the violators will be deprived of the qualification for the rewards;
All participants must strictly comply with KuCoin Terms of Use. KuCoin reserves all rights to the final explanation of the event;
Investments in digital assets can be risky. Please carefully evaluate the risks of a product and your risk tolerance based on your own financial circumstances;
Apple is not a sponsor or involved in the activity in any manner.
